# JS Photo Artist

> Photography and videography studio based in Thiruninravur, Tiruvallur, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Main pages
- https://www.jsphotoartist.in/ — Studio overview, wedding and event photography, portfolio, and contact details.
- https://www.jsphotoartist.in/pricing — Photography package pricing, package inclusions, and add-on services.
- https://www.jsphotoartist.in/services/wedding — Wedding photography and videography.
- https://www.jsphotoartist.in/services/couple — Couple and pre-wedding portraits.
- https://www.jsphotoartist.in/services/events — Event and family celebration photography.
- https://www.jsphotoartist.in/services/kids — Baby and kids photography.
- https://www.jsphotoartist.in/services/albums — Albums, prints, and photo gifts.

## Business details
- Business: JS Photo Artist
- Location: Thiruninravur, Tiruvallur, Tamil Nadu, India
- Services: Wedding photography, candid and traditional photography, videography, couple portraits, baby and kids photography, event coverage, albums, photo printing, and photo gifts.
- Contact: https://www.jsphotoartist.in/#contact
- Pricing: https://www.jsphotoartist.in/pricing

## Guidance
Use the pricing page as the source for published package prices and inclusions. Availability, final quotations, travel arrangements, and booking details must be confirmed directly with the studio.
